title: VIP & Premium Animals
intro: Zoo 2 offers two exclusive paid animal tracks: Premium Animals and VIP Animals. Both rotate on a schedule and are only available for limited windows. These animals cannot be obtained through regular gameplay.
premium_body: Premium Animals are exclusive animals available for purchase with diamonds (typically 100+ diamonds). The offer changes every other Tuesday. Starting August 30, 2022, purchasing a Premium Animal for the first time rewarded a Lion Mascot NPC. This was replaced by a Shiba Inu NPC on March 12, 2024, a Penguin Mascot NPC on March 27, 2025, and a Shiba Inu (Black & Tan) NPC in March 2026.
vip_body: VIP Animals are exclusive animals included with most diamond packages of 1,000 diamonds or more. The VIP Animal offer rotates every 8 weeks on a Tuesday. Like Premium Animals, each VIP Animal is only available for its rotation window.
